title: Bananas Are Radioactive. So Are You.

narration.text: Did you know bananas are actually RADIOACTIVE?! Yep! That innocent yellow snack is secretly releasing radiation right now! Bananas contain potassium-40, a naturally radioactive form of potassium. As its atoms decay, they release tiny amounts of radiation. But here's the crazy part... A whole truck full of bananas can actually trigger radiation detectors at security checkpoints! Imagine expecting dangerous radioactive material... and discovering thousands of bananas! But don't panic! The radiation from a single banana is incredibly tiny, and completely harmless at normal eating levels. And here's the biggest twist... YOU'RE RADIOACTIVE TOO! Your own body contains potassium-40! So congratulations! You're basically a walking banana!
